{"claims":[{"claim_text":"The premises of Cold War targeting should no longer dictate the size of the U.S. nuclear arsenal.",
"claim_types":["evaluation"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"The current administration does not realize that the premises of Cold War targeting should no longer dictate the size of the U.S. nuclear arsenal.",
"claim_types":["characterization"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"The United States should work with other nuclear nations to remove as many weapons as possible from high-alert, hair-trigger status to reduce the risks of accidental or unauthorized launch.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"In 1991, the United States invited the Soviet Union to join it in removing tactical nuclear weapons from their arsenals, and huge reductions were achieved in a matter of months.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[2]},{"claim_text":"Under a Republican president, Russia will again be invited to remove strategic nuclear weapons from its arsenal.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[2]},{"claim_text":"America should lead by example in reducing nuclear weapons because it is in the best interest of the United States and the world.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[2]},{"claim_text":"These measures can begin a new global era of nuclear security and safety.",
"claim_types":["prediction"],"evidence_ids":[2]},{"claim_text":"Republicans recognize new threats and new opportunities.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[3]},{"claim_text":"With Republican leadership, the United States has an opportunity to create a safer world by defending against nuclear threats and reducing nuclear arsenals and tensions.",
"claim_types":["prediction"],"evidence_ids":[3]},{"claim_text":"America can build a robust missile defense, make dramatic reductions in its nuclear weapons, and defuse confrontation with Russia.",
"claim_types":["prediction"],"evidence_ids":[3]},{"claim_text":"A Republican President will build a robust missile defense, make dramatic reductions in its nuclear weapons, and defuse confrontation with Russia.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[3]}],"unresolved_references":[]}
```
